scope: Conservative cleanup of expired reliable-sync snapshot files

integration_cases: expired file deletion with immutable ledger retention
dry-run preview and idempotent repeated cleanup
manifest symlink refusal even with matching content
daily worker fails closed on refusal

known_boundary: The legacy database has no formal published changes or sync snapshots, so its real-data retention preview is correctly empty. change_log is retained indefinitely; physical history compaction requires a separate design because publication ledgers reference change sequence numbers.
